description: This file defines a React functional component called BudgetPanel that manages and displays a list of budget items. It includes functionalities for creating, editing, and deleting budgets, along with UI elements like tables, modals, and tabbed code snippets for usage instructions.

methods.name: handleEditCall
methods.description: Sets the selected budget and displays the edit modal for editing an existing budget.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Sets the selected budget and shows the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the selected budget via API call and updates the list.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Closes the delete modal without performing any action.

methods.name: handleUpdateCall
methods.description: Reloads the budget list from the server.
